title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Harvey Mudd spaces for making, studying, gathering, recreation, art, and residence-hall community, verified through current College sources.

cards.title: Build Beyond the Assignment
cards.subtitle: First floor of the Scott A. McGregor Computer Science Center
cards.notes: Bring a personal or class project, then work near stewards who can assist with equipment; confirm required training before using specialized tools.
cards.short_summary: An 8,000-square-foot, student-run workspace supporting projects from electronics and fabrication to sewing and art.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd identifies the Makerspace as an 8,000-square-foot, student-run facility with tools, resources, work areas, meeting rooms, storage, and specialized equipment for personal and academic projects.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 only to 7C students, faculty, and staff. Stewards are available Sunday–Thursday noon–11 p.m. and Friday–Saturday noon–8 p.m.; equipment may require training.

cards.entity_name: Scott A. McGregor Computer Science Center
cards.title: Settle Into a Collaboration Zone
cards.subtitle: Study and project space inside McGregor Center
cards.notes: Use the lobby or collaboration areas for a group session, keeping labs and project rooms clear unless your course or program authorizes access.
cards.short_summary: A computer science building designed with substantial areas for studying, project work, informal meetings, and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says McGregor Center contains student study and collaboration space, project work areas, and an expansive first-floor lobby with study, hangout, and collaboration areas.
cards.source_title: McGregor Computer Science Center Receives Design Award | Harvey Mudd College News
cards.access_notes: Use common study and collaboration areas during authorized building access; laboratories, Clinic areas, offices, and project rooms may have separate restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Ronald and Maxine Linde Activities Center
cards.title: Choose a Game, Workout, or Hangout
cards.subtitle: The LAC at 450 E. Foothill Boulevard
cards.notes: Swipe in for the gym, game room, lounge, or equipment desk; check the posted academic-year schedule before crossing campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused recreation center combining fitness rooms, a gymnasium, games, a lounge, and equipment checkout.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd describes the LAC as containing a gymnasium, aerobics room, weight room, computer lab, lounge, and game room, with sporting and camping equipment available for checkout.
cards.source_title: Linde Activities Center | Campus Life | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Not open to the public and requires student entry procedures. The College states it is closed for summer 2026 and will reopen in fall 2026; verify new semester hours before visiting.

cards.title: Keep Studying Through a Reservation
cards.subtitle: Shared study area in Joseph B. Platt Campus Center
cards.notes: Set up here for individual or group work; even when an event reserves the room, College policy preserves student study access.
cards.short_summary: A formally designated student study area whose shared access continues while approved events use the room.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s facilities policy states that the Platt Campus Center Living Room is used by all HMC students as a study area and remains accessible to students during reserved events.
cards.source_title: Facilities Use Policy | Facilities and Maintenance | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Student study access continues during reservations, but approved events may share the room. Follow posted building-access requirements and do not prop open doors.

cards.title: Move the Meeting Outdoors
cards.subtitle: Reservable exterior gathering space by Kingston Hall
cards.notes: Use the courtyard for an approved club or group gathering, allowing setup and cleanup time when submitting the required reservation.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor meeting area available to students and other College groups through the campus reservation process.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd lists Kingston Courtyard as an exterior meeting area reserved on a first-come, first-served basis for students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Facilities Use Policy | Facilities and Maintenance | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Organized use requires an approved reservation made through the College system; off-campus requests are subject to approval. Include setup and cleanup time.

cards.title: Give a Campus Gathering More Room
cards.subtitle: Exterior meeting area at Platt Campus Center
cards.notes: Plan a student gathering here through the reservation system, and build preparation, breakdown, and audiovisual checks into the booking.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza that the College makes available for approved student, faculty, and staff gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s facilities policy identifies Platt Campus Center’s Riggs Plaza as an exterior space reserved first come, first served for students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Facilities Use Policy | Facilities and Maintenance | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Organized use requires College approval and a reservation. Off-campus requests are considered separately; users should include setup and breakdown time.

cards.entity_name: Caryll Mudd and Norman F. Sprague Jr. Gallery
cards.title: See What the Campus Is Making
cards.subtitle: Lower level of the R. Michael Shanahan Center
cards.notes: Drop in during gallery hours to view current work, then check the exhibition listing before assuming a particular installation remains on display.
cards.short_summary: A glass-fronted campus gallery primarily presenting work by Harvey Mudd students, faculty, staff, and sometimes alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd states that Sprague Gallery curates exhibitions mainly featuring student, faculty, and staff artwork, while its visitor page locates the gallery in Shanahan Center.
cards.source_title: Visual Arts — Arts at Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: The gallery visitor page lists regular hours as Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., with added event hours. Exhibitions are public unless an event description says otherwise.

cards.entity_name: Ronald and Maxine Linde Residence Hall
cards.title: Share the Communal Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Resident gathering space in Linde Hall
cards.notes: Coordinate ingredients and cleanup with residents before using the shared kitchen, and treat dorm meetings or barbecues as resident-led activities.
cards.short_summary: A residence hall where the official housing guide documents a communal kitchen and recurring resident gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s residence-hall guide says Linde residents bond through dorm meetings, weekly barbecues, and baking in the communal kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls | Housing and Residential Life | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Residential space; access is for residents and their authorized guests under current housing rules. Coordinate kitchen use with residents and follow posted safety requirements.

cards.title: Take a Casual Game Into the Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Shared outdoor space at North Residence Hall
cards.notes: Join residents for a low-key courtyard game or use the adjacent grass, keeping paths clear and respecting residence-hall quiet expectations.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall courtyard documented as a setting for conversation, informal games, and time on the grass.
cards.evidence_claim: The official housing page says North Hall residents socialize and play hacky sack, frisbee, and basketball in the courtyard or lounge on the grass.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls | Housing and Residential Life | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: The courtyard serves a residence hall. Visitors should accompany or coordinate with a resident and follow housing, noise, and guest policies.

cards.entity_name: Wayne ’73 and Julie Drinkward Residence Hall
cards.title: Find the Living Learning Community
cards.subtitle: Home of Harvey Mudd’s LLC
cards.notes: Watch for LLC programs announced to the wider HMC community; attend only events identified as open rather than entering residential areas uninvited.
cards.short_summary: A residence hall housing a Living Learning Community that organizes social-justice events for the Harvey Mudd student body.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s housing page identifies Drinkward Hall as home to the Living Learning Community, whose Mudder members host social-justice events for all HMC students.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls | Housing and Residential Life | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall access is limited to residents and authorized guests. LLC events may welcome all HMC students when announced; verify each event’s location and access terms.
